caption:
Who's wearing the lab coat here?

"The vet examined the puppy wearing a white lab coat" puts the coat on the puppy. Move the modifier next to the noun it describes.

Comment your fix below.
tiktok_caption: Who's wearing the lab coat: the vet or the puppy?

youtube.title: Misplaced Modifiers on the SAT: Who's Wearing the Coat?
youtube.description: A modifier describes whatever it sits next to. Move it beside the noun it's meant to describe.
